summary: Coding agents solve repository issues through long sequences of exploration, editing, and validation. These trajectories are increasingly used as post-training data, so how they are collected shapes what the trained model learns.
takeaways: These trajectories are increasingly used as post-training data, so how they are collected shapes what the trained model learns.
We evaluate collection approaches by training student models on the trajectories they produce.
A natural way to use this history is to expose it to the coding agent as advice.
